description: Open source previs software in the browser: block a scene, pose characters, author camera moves and cuts, then take the same shots to an AI video model.

latest_release.name: CozyClay v3.3.3
latest_release.body:
Runs and jumps move like captured people, the two legs of a body fold apart, a scene can hold a rope, and a request to the Studio agent finishes sooner and costs less.

Motion

- A run follows captured runners of its speed: step rate, stride, the share
  of each cycle in the air, the pelvis path, the chest's turn and the arm
  swing come from gait curves by speed, the way a walk already works. A
  straight jog or run no longer dips the hips on single frames. (#1361)
- A body can leave the ground under gravity. `launch`, the word a prop
  already flies by, works for a body: a jump, a hop, a leap or a drop
  follows the path gravity gives from the frame the body leaves the ground
  to the place it comes down, and the frames before and after take the
  speed up and down. A walk, run or push written straight before a launch
  does not stop first: one foot pushes off and the legs stride in the air.
  A landing never puts the body under the floor. (#1361)
- `sit`, `stand`, `kneel` and `idle` take `feet`, `lead` and `lag`: a foot
  steps to a new place and stays planted, one leg folds or straightens
  first and the other follows. The same words give one knee down, a lunge,
  a tucked foot or a crouch with one foot ahead. With nothing written, one
  leg leads and the other follows a little later with a small pelvis roll.
  A `stand` after a `kneel` rises from it. (#1361)
- A scene prop can be a line (a rope, a cable, a strap):
  `{ id, line: { length, thick }, at }`. The engine solves its chain of
  segments on every frame; `tie`, `over`, `untie`, `hide`, `show` and a
  hand's `hold` key it. The Studio shows it as one object per segment and
  reads the scene back as one line. (#1361)
- A hand keyed in the body's frame before a walk or run keeps swinging with
  the gait when it lies on the line a hanging hand swings over. A pose
  key's `inout` blend follows the minimum-jerk curve, so a move between two
  keys starts and ends softer and peaks higher in the middle. (#1361)
- The motion tool's answer tells more of what the clip does: an `air` block
  for every launch (frames in the air, height, take-off and landing speeds,
  where it landed), a `legs` block (which knee came to the floor and when)
  and a `lines` block (taut or slack per span, a fastening that jumped).
  (#1361)

Agent

- A request to the Studio agent is shorter and cheaper. On 8 new requests
  run twice on each version, a request took 255 s where it took 324 s and
  cost 1.55 USD where it cost 2.09 USD; two runs of the same request on the
  same version differ by 66 s and 0.52 USD, and without one request that
  was long on the old version the time is 233 s against 262 s. (#1367)
- A script answers with the pictures of what it made or checked (up to 8),
  where each picture needed a call of its own. Each line of a script's
  result keeps its warnings, missing paths and the place of a refusal.
  (#1367)
- Every tool refusal has one form: which argument, what was sent, what is
  allowed, and whether anything changed. When a call on something a running
  motion holds could not be undone, the refusal says that the change is
  unknown instead of saying that nothing changed. (#1367)
- The motion tool's first answer names the characters and props the motion
  holds, other tools' answers carry the motion's state while it runs, and
  the draft and the result carry the facts of the compile: who does what at
  which frame, where the hips are and where they face. (#1367)
- A finished clip survives a refused install and can be installed again, a
  transient error on the motion writer's model request is retried, and the
  props of the writer's first scene appear as placeholders at once. (#1367)
- The motion writer is told only real differences. A value the engine gives
  when nothing is wrong (a prop held in one hand with no drift and no turn)
  is no longer a row, a row lists the other places of its kind so they
  surface together, and a row's "was" mark compares a place with itself

English · 한국어 · 日本語 · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · Español · Français · Deutsch · Português (BR) · Русский

Make the scene first. Then make it a video.
Open source previs in a browser tab: block the set, move the cast, cut the camera, hand the shot to an AI video model.

Try it in the browser · Quick start · Guide for AI agents · Docs · Changelog · Discord

Top: the greybox blocked in CozyClay. Bottom: the AI video made from it. Same idea, a parkour jump: the blocking holds the timing and the camera.
## Why AI video costs money per take, and one miss means paying again. A text prompt cannot hold a whole scene: where everyone stands, how they move, where the camera is, when it cuts. CozyClay lets you make those decisions first, in 3D, where they are cheap to change. Then the video model gets the shot as a first frame, a greybox reference clip and a prompt that describes the real framing. It follows the blocking instead of guessing. ```mermaid flowchart LR S["Stage
set + cast"] --> M["Motion
written + built"] --> C["Camera
shots + cuts"] --> E["Export
frame · clip · prompt"] --> V["AI video model"] ``` ## Quick start ```bash npx cozyclay ``` That is the whole install. You need Node.js 22.19 or newer and a Chromium browser. You do not need a GPU, Python or a model download. The studio opens at `http://127.0.0.1:5180/app/`. **Updating.** - `npx cozyclay` fetches the newest release on every run. - After `npm install -g cozyclay`, the studio shows an **Update** chip in the top bar when a release is out. **Update now** installs it. **Restart now** starts the new version in the same terminal. - On Windows the chip shows the command to copy instead. One-click update stays off there by design. - `cclay update` does the same from the terminal. - Turn the check off for one launch with `--no-update-check` or `COZYCLAY_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`. Turn it off for good with `cclay update --off`, and back on with `cclay update --on`. > **Asking an AI agent to set it up?** Give it this repository link. Its instructions are in > [`INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md`](INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md). ## What you can do | | | | --- | --- | | **Stage** | Build the set from primitives and place point, spot and directional lights. Add rig characters, drawn as cube figures, or capsule stand-ins when nobody needs to move a limb. Fly the view like a 3D editor. | | **Move** | Describe the action in the Agent panel. A second model, the motion writer, writes a motion spec, and a deterministic engine makes every frame and measures foot slide, contacts, balance and bodies inside props. The writer reads those numbers and contact sheets of the result before the take goes in. A motion can move props too. Runs and jumps follow captured human motion, sitting down, standing up and kneeling move the two legs apart, and a scene can hold a rope that is tied, draped, held and let go. It needs a model sign-in in the Agent panel. | | **Shoot** | Put shots on a timeline, draw dolly rails in the Top-View, look through the lens. Turn a rail camera by hand and pick who it follows. Each shot knows the limits of the video model you target. A shot camera can look straight down or straight up, and each camera key can choose how its move is eased. | | **Export** | Keyframe pack (first and last frame, greybox clip, camera, prompt), AI video reference zip (a mosaic-and-blur reference video and a prompt), mp4, depth and normal passes, contact sheet, OTIO cut list. | | **Look** | The toon look (flat two-tone shading with black lines) is on by default in the viewport and in every capture and export. Turn it off under **Show** in the viewport toolbar. | | **Undo anything** | Every edit, including each change the agent makes, is one undo step. | ## Direct it with AI The same scene can be driven from three places, live, while you watch the viewport. | Surface | Start | For | | --- | --- | --- | | **Agent panel** | `Cmd/Ctrl+B` in the studio | Chat in the studio. Sign in with ChatGPT or use your own key (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, MiniMax, OpenRouter, CLIProxyAPI). | | **MCP server** | `npx -y cozyclay mcp` | Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client. | | **Terminal** | `cclay live status --wait` | Coding agents that drive a running studio, JSON in and out. | ```json { "mcpServers": { "cozyclay": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "cozyclay", "mcp"] } } } ``` ## From source ```bash git clone https://github.com/HaD0Yun/CozyClay.git && cd CozyClay npm install npm run dev # http://127.0.0.1:5180/app/ npm test ``` Contribution rules are in [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md). Open pull requests against `main`. ## Docs | Read | For | | --- | --- | | [`INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md`](INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md) | Install, run and connect, written for AI agents | | [`docs/motion3-agent-guide.md`](docs/motion3-agent-guide.md) | The old motion engine (MCP, `cclay live`, `COZYCLAY_MOTION_ENGINE=old`): motion specs, compile and QA | | [`docs/agent-cli.md`](docs/agent-cli.md) | `cclay live`, model providers, sessions | | [`mcp/README.md`](mcp/README.md) | MCP tools and the live protocol | | [`docs/studio-ui-ia.md`](docs/studio-ui-ia.md) | Every control and where it lives | | [`docs/privacy.md`](docs/privacy.md) | Anonymous telemetry and how to turn it off (`cclay telemetry off`) | | [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) | Contribution rules | ## Guides | Read | For | | --- | --- | | [Greybox to AI video](https://cozyclay.org/greybox-to-video/) | Why a grey blockout is the most reliable input for a video model, and the block-then-generate loop | | [Previs software compared](https://cozyclay.org/previs-software/) | Free, open source and browser-based previs tools side by side | | [Seedance 2.5 camera control](https://cozyclay.org/seedance-camera-control/) | Getting the same camera on every take with a reference clip | | [Camera control for AI video](https://cozyclay.org/ai-camera-control/) | Why camera prompts drift and what the models actually accept | Found a bug or want a feature? [Open an issue](https://github.com/HaD0Yun/CozyClay/issues). ## License AGPL-3.0-or-later. See [`LICENSE`](LICENSE), [`LICENSING.md`](LICENSING.md) and [`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md). Made by [Doyun](https://github.com/HaD0Yun) at [NomaDamas](https://github.com/NomaDamas).

先做场景，再做视频。
浏览器标签页里的开源预演工具:搭场景、调度角色、切镜头,再把镜头交给 AI 视频模型。

在浏览器中试用 · 快速开始 · AI 代理指南 · 更新日志 · Discord

上:在 CozyClay 中搭好的灰盒。下:据此生成的 AI 视频。 同样的思路,一个跑酷跳跃:预演锁定了节奏和镜头。
## 为什么需要它 AI 视频每出一条都要花钱,一次不中就得再付一次。单靠文字提示词,装不下整个场景:每个人站在哪、怎么动、摄影机在哪、何时切镜头。 CozyClay 让你先在 3D 里把这些决定做好,这时修改成本最低。随后视频模型拿到的是首帧、灰盒参考片段,以及描述真实构图的提示词。它会遵循预演,而不是自己猜。 ```mermaid flowchart LR S["Stage
set + cast"] --> M["Motion
written + built"] --> C["Camera
shots + cuts"] --> E["Export
frame · clip · prompt"] --> V["AI video model"] ``` ## 快速开始 ```bash npx cozyclay ``` 安装只需这一步。需要 Node.js 22.19 或更高版本,以及 Chromium 内核浏览器。不需要 GPU、Python,也不用下载模型。工作室会在 `http://127.0.0.1:5180/app/` 打开。 **更新。** - `npx cozyclay` 每次运行都会获取最新版本。 - 用 `npm install -g cozyclay` 安装后,有新版本时工作室顶栏会出现 **Update** 标签。**Update now** 负责安装,**Restart now** 在同一终端启动新版本。 - 在 Windows 上,标签会显示可复制的命令。一键更新在此处被有意关闭。 - 在终端中,`cclay update` 效果相同。 - 单次启动要关闭检查,用 `--no-update-check` 或 `COZYCLAY_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`。永久关闭用 `cclay update --off`,重新开启用 `cclay update --on`。 > **让 AI 代理帮你安装?** 把本仓库链接给它即可。说明在 > [`INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md`](INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md)。 ## 你能做什么 | | | | --- | --- | | **Stage** | 用基本体搭建场景,放置点光源、聚光灯和平行光。添加带骨骼的角色,画成方块人;不需要动四肢时,用胶囊体替身。像 3D 编辑器一样飞行查看。 | | **Move** | 在 Agent 面板中描述动作。第二个模型(动作编写者)编写动作规格,确定性引擎生成每一帧,并测量脚滑、接触、平衡以及穿入道具的身体。编写者在动作片段装入之前读取这些数值和结果的联系表。动作也可以移动道具。跑步和跳跃遵循捕捉到的真人动作,坐下、起身和跪下时两条腿分别运动,场景中还可以放一根能系住、搭挂、握住和松开的绳子。需要在 Agent 面板中登录一个模型。 | | **Shoot** | 把镜头放到时间线上,在 Top-View 中画轨道,通过镜头取景。可以手动转动轨道摄影机,并选择它跟随谁。每个镜头都清楚目标视频模型的限制。镜头摄影机可以垂直向下或向上看,每个摄影机关键帧都可以选择运动的缓动方式。 | | **Export** | 关键帧包(首帧和末帧、灰盒片段、摄影机、提示词)、AI 视频参考 zip(马赛克加模糊的参考视频和提示词)、mp4、深度和法线通道、联系表、OTIO 剪辑列表。 | | **Look** | 卡通外观(黑色线条加两级明暗的平面画法)在视口以及所有截图和导出中默认开启。在视口工具栏的 **Show** 中关闭。 | | **Undo anything** | 每一次编辑,包括代理做的每个改动,都是一个撤销步骤。 | ## 用 AI 来导演 同一个场景可以从三处实时驱动,你可以边看视口边操作。 | 方式 | 启动 | 适用 | | --- | --- | --- | | **Agent panel** | `Cmd/Ctrl+B` | 工作室内的聊天。用 ChatGPT 登录,或使用自己的密钥(Anthropic、OpenAI、Gemini、MiniMax、OpenRouter、CLIProxyAPI)。 | | **MCP server** | `npx -y cozyclay mcp` | Claude Desktop、Claude Code、Cursor 或任意 MCP 客户端。 | | **Terminal** | `cclay live status --wait` | 驱动运行中工作室的编码代理,输入输出均为 JSON。 | ```json { "mcpServers": { "cozyclay": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "cozyclay", "mcp"] } } } ``` ## 从源码运行 ```bash git clone https://github.com/HaD0Yun/CozyClay.git && cd CozyClay npm install npm run dev # http://127.0.0.1:5180/app/ npm test ``` 贡献规则见 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)。请向 `main` 提交拉取请求。 ## 文档 | 阅读 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | [`INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md`](INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md) | 面向 AI 代理的安装、运行和连接说明 | | [`docs/motion3-agent-guide.md`](docs/motion3-agent-guide.md) | 旧动作引擎(MCP、`cclay live`、`COZYCLAY_MOTION_ENGINE=old`)的动作规格、编译与 QA | | [`docs/agent-cli.md`](docs/agent-cli.md) | `cclay live`、模型提供方、会话 | | [`mcp/README.md`](mcp/README.md) | MCP 工具与实时协议 | | [`docs/studio-ui-ia.md`](docs/studio-ui-ia.md) | 每个控件及其位置 | | [`docs/privacy.md`](docs/privacy.md) | 匿名遥测及关闭方法(`cclay telemetry off`) | | [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md) | 贡献规则 | ## 指南 | 阅读 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | [Greybox to AI video](https://cozyclay.org/greybox-to-video/) | 为什么灰色白模是视频模型最可靠的输入,以及先预演再生成的流程 | | [Previs software compared](https://cozyclay.org/previs-software/) | 免费、开源、基于浏览器的预演工具对比 | | [Seedance 2.5 camera control](https://cozyclay.org/seedance-camera-control/) | 用参考片段让每次生成的镜头保持一致 | | [Camera control for AI video](https://cozyclay.org/ai-camera-control/) | 摄影机提示词为何会漂移,以及模型实际接受什么 | 发现 bug 或想要新功能?[提交 issue](https://github.com/HaD0Yun/CozyClay/issues)。 ##
